_doc: Claymore (attacker pool; research/gadgets.md §3.3). Two each (Y7S1.2); placed on the floor facing the placer's way; electronic (a Bulletproof Camera's dart disables it, Y6S4). How long it takes to place, its reach and its size are placeholders. Its blast: 155 hp (Y11S3) within 2 m, none past 6 m (Fandom), in the 180° in front of it and 1 m behind it; it cuts nothing (not documented). Its tripwire: three 2 m lasers, ahead and 30° either side, armed 1 s after it's placed; a defender crossing one sets it off at once (Y9S3). One bullet destroys it (Y9S3).
name: Claymore
